purpose: Hard gate for any suicide, self-harm, overdose, substance-related death, postvention, or survivor-risk material.
hard_rules: No method, means, scene mechanics, location specificity that implies method, note contents, photos, screenshots, or direct messages.
No single-cause explanations for suicide or overdose death.
No romanticization, fatalism, blame, criminalizing shorthand, stigma, voyeurism, or public speculation.
No overdose response, suicide prevention, school, workplace, clinical, legal, forensic, or therapy instructions.
No public child/adolescent survivor material without exceptional pediatric and suicide-safe review.
No public resource-routing surface until crisis/survivor-support review is complete.
